summary: agents pin their model and effort, core-lint enforces it, and the model each helper really ran on is logged
appCreator: Helper agents (qa, planner, reviewer) now run on Sonnet at a fixed effort instead of inheriting the thread's model, so a helper no longer runs on Opus by accident. Ad-hoc helpers default to Sonnet. Each finished helper's real model is logged in /tmp/studio-hooks.log (a subagent line). Skills keep following the thread's model until a one-time check passes.
notVerified: That a Project thread honours an agent's pinned model: the one-time manual check after release shows it. Whether the SubagentStop input carries the agent's own transcript path in Project threads is checked by the branch scenario.
